full.text: The human heart has a special system for rhythmic self-excitation and repetitive contraction approximately 100,000 times each day or 3 billion times in the average human lifetime. This impressive feat is performed by a system that does the following: (1) generates electrical impulses to initiate rhythmical contraction of the heart muscle; and (2) conducts these impulses rapidly through the heart. When this system functions normally, the atria contract about one-sixth of a second ahead of ventricular contraction, which allows filling of the ventricles before they pump blood through the lungs and peripheral circu lation. Another especially important feature of the system is that it allows all portions of the ventricles to contract almost simultaneously, which is essential for the most effective pressure generation in the ventricular chambers.

This rhythmical and conductive system of the heart is susceptible to damage by heart disease, especially by ischemia resulting from inadequate coronary blood flow. The effect is often a bizarre heart rhythm or an abnor mal sequence of contraction of the heart chambers, and the pumping effectiveness of the heart can be affected severely, even to the extent of causing death.
SPECIALIZED EXCITATORY AND CONDUCTIVE SYSTEM OF THE HEART

**Figure 10-1** shows the specialized excitatory and con ductive system of the heart that controls cardiac con tractions. The figure shows the sinus node (also called sinoatrial [S-A] node), in which the normal rhythmical impulses are generated; the internodal pathways that con duct impulses from the sinus node to the atrioventricular (A-V) node; the A-V node in which impulses from the atria are delayed before passing into the ventricles; the A-V bundle, which conducts impulses from the atria into the ventricles; and the left and right bundle branches of Purkinje fibers, which conduct the cardiac impulses to all parts of the ventricles.
SINUS (SINOATRIAL) NODE

The sinus node is a small, flattened, ellipsoid strip of spe cialized cardiac muscle about 3 mm wide, 15 mm long, and 1 mm thick. It is located in the superior posterolateral wall of the right atrium immediately below and slightly lateral to the opening of the superior vena cava. The fibers of this node have almost no contractile muscle filaments and are each only 3 to 5 micrometers (μm) in diameter, in contrast to a diameter of 10 to 15 μm for the surround ing atrial muscle fibers. However, the sinus nodal fibers connect directly with the atrial muscle fibers, so that any action potential that begins in the sinus node spreads immediately into the atrial muscle wall.
AUTOMATIC ELECTRICAL RHYTHMICITY OF THE SINUS FIBERS

Some cardiac fibers have the capability of _self-excitation_, a process that can cause automatic rhythmical discharge and contraction. This capability is especially true of the heart’s specialized conducting system, including fibers of the sinus node. For this reason, the sinus node ordinarily controls the beat rate of the entire heart, as discussed in detail later in this chapter. First, let us describe this auto matic rhythmicity.

**Figure 102** shows action potentials recorded from inside a sinus nodal fiber for three heartbeats and, by comparison, a single ventricular muscle fiber action potential. Note that the resting membrane potential of the sinus nodal fiber between discharges is about –55 to –60 millivolts, in comparison with –85 to –90 millivolts for the ventricu lar muscle fiber. The cause of this lower negativity is that the cell membranes of the sinus fibers are naturally leaky to sodium and calcium ions, and positive charges of the entering sodium and calcium ions neutralize some of the intracellular negativity.

Before we explain the rhythmicity of the sinus nodal fibers, first recall from the discussions of Chapters 5 and 9 that cardiac muscle has three main types of membrane ion channels that play important roles in causing the voltage changes of the action potential. They are (1) _fast sodium channels_, (2) _calcium channels (particularly L-type_ or _“slow” calcium channels)_, and (3) _potassium channels_ (see **Figure 9-5**).

Opening of the fast sodium channels for a few 10,000ths of a second is responsible for the rapid upstroke spike of the action potential observed in ventricular mus cle because of rapid influx of positive sodium ions to the interior of the fiber. Then, the plateau of the ventricular action potential is caused primarily by slower opening of the slow sodium-calcium channels, which lasts for about 0.3 second. Finally, opening of potassium channels allows for the diffusion of large amounts of positive potassium ions in the outward direction through the fiber membrane and returns the membrane potential to its resting level.

However, there is a difference in the function of these channels in the sinus nodal fiber because the resting potential is much less negative—only –55 millivolts in the nodal fiber instead of the –90 millivolts in the ven tricular muscle fiber. At this level of –55 millivolts, the fast sodium channels mainly have already become inacti vated, or blocked. This is because any time the membrane potential remains less negative than about –55 millivolts for more than a few milliseconds, the inactivation gates on the inside of the cell membrane that close the fast sodium channels become closed and remain so. There fore, only the slow sodium-calcium channels can open (i.e., can become activated) and thereby cause the action potential. As a result, the atrial nodal action potential is slower to develop than the action potential of the ventric ular muscle. Also, after the action potential does occur, return of the potential to its negative state occurs slowly as well, rather than the abrupt return that occurs for the ventricular fiber.

Because of the high sodi um ion concentration in the extracellular fluid outside the nodal fiber, as well as a moderate number of already open sodium channels, positive sodium ions from outside the fibers normally tend to leak to the inside through inward, “funny” currents. Therefore, between heartbeats, the in flux of positively charged sodium ions causes a slow rise in the resting membrane potential in the positive direc tion. Thus, as shown in **Figure 10-2**, the resting potential gradually rises and becomes less negative between each two heartbeats. When the potential reaches a threshold voltage of about –40 millivolts, the L-type calcium chan nels become activated, thus causing the action potential. Therefore, basically, the inherent leakiness of the sinus nodal fibers to sodium and calcium ions causes their selfexcitation.
full.lead: Leakiness of Sinus Nodal Fibers to Sodium and Calcium Causes Self-Excitation.

full.text: Why does this leakiness to sodium and calcium ions not cause the sinus nodal fibers to remain depolarized all the time? Two events occur during the course of the action potential to prevent such a constant state of depo larization. First, the L-type calcium channels become inactivated (i.e., they close) within about 100 to 150 mil liseconds after opening; and second, at about the same time, greatly increased numbers of potassium channels open. Therefore, influx of positive calcium and sodium ions through the L-type calcium channels ceases, while at the same time large quantities of positive potassium ions diffuse out of the fiber. Both these effects reduce the intracellular potential back to its negative resting level and therefore terminate the action potential. Furthermore, the potassium channels remain open for another few tenths of a second, temporarily continuing movement of posi tive charges out of the cell, with resultant excess negativity inside the fiber; this process is called _hyperpolarization._ The hyperpolarization state initially carries the resting membrane potential down to about –55 to –60 millivolts at the termination of the action potential.

Why is this new state of hyperpolarization not main tained forever? The reason is that during the next few tenths of a second after the action potential is over, pro gressively more and more potassium channels close. The inward-leaking sodium (“funny” current) and calcium ions once again overbalance the outward flux of potas sium ions, which causes the resting potential to drift upward once more, finally reaching the threshold level for discharge at a potential of about –40 millivolts. Then, the entire process begins again: self-excitation to cause the action potential, recovery from the action potential, hyperpolarization after the action potential is over, drift of the resting potential to threshold, and finally re-excitation to elicit another cycle. This process continues throughout a person’s life.
INTERNODAL AND INTERATRIAL PATHWAYS TRANSMIT CARDIAC IMPULSES THROUGH THE ATRIA

The ends of the sinus nodal fibers connect directly with the surrounding atrial muscle fibers. Therefore, action potentials originating in the sinus node travel outward into these atrial muscle fibers. In this way, the action potential spreads through the entire atrial muscle mass and, eventually, to the A-V node. The velocity of conduc tion in most atrial muscle is about 0.3 m/sec, but conduc tion is more rapid, about 1 m/sec, in several small bands of atrial fibers. One of these bands, called the _anterior interatrial band_ (also called _Bachman’s bundle_), passes through the anterior walls of the atria to the left atrium. In addition, three other small bands curve through the ante rior, lateral, and posterior atrial walls and terminate in the A-V node, shown in **Figure 10-1** and **Figure 10-3**; these are called, respectively, the _anterior, middle,_ and _posterior internodal pathways_. The cause of more rapid velocity of conduction in these bands is the presence of specialized conduction fibers. These fibers are similar to even more rapidly conducting Purkinje fibers of the ventricles, dis cussed below.
THE ATRIOVENTRICULAR NODE DELAYS IMPULSE CONDUCTION FROM THE ATRIA TO THE VENTRICLES

The atrial conductive system is organized so that the car diac impulse does not travel from the atria into the ven tricles too rapidly; this delay allows time for the atria to empty their blood into the ventricles before ventricular contraction begins. It is primarily the A-V node and its adjacent conductive fibers that delay this transmission into the ventricles.

The A-V node is located in the posterior wall of the right atrium, immediately behind the tricuspid valve, as shown in **Figure 10-1**. **Figure 10-3** diagrams the differ ent parts of this node, plus its connections with the enter ing atrial internodal pathway fibers and the exiting A-V bundle. This figure also shows the approximate intervals of time (in fractions of a second) between the initial onset of the cardiac impulse in the sinus node and its subse quent appearance in the A-V nodal system. Note that the impulse, after traveling through the internodal pathways, reaches the A-V node about 0.03 second after its origin in the sinus node. Then, there is a delay of another 0.09 sec ond in the A-V node itself before the impulse enters the penetrating portion of the A-V bundle, where it passes into the ventricles. A final delay of another 0.04 second occurs mainly in this penetrating A-V bundle, which is composed of multiple small fascicles passing through the fibrous tissue separating the atria from the ventricles.

Thus, the total delay in the A-V nodal and A-V bundle system is about 0.13 second. This delay, in addition to the initial conduction delay of 0.03 second from the sinus node to the A-V node, makes a total delay of 0.16 second before the excitatory signal finally reaches the contracting muscle of the ventricles.

The slow conduction in the transitional, nodal, and penetrating A-V bundle fibers is caused mainly by diminished numbers of gap junctions between successive cells in the conducting pathways, so there is great resistance to conduction of excitatory ions from one conducting fiber to the next. Therefore, it is easy to see why each succeeding cell is slow to be excited.
RAPID TRANSMISSION OF THE CARDIAC IMPULSE IN THE VENTRICULAR PURKINJE SYSTEM

Special Purkinje fibers lead from the A-V node through the A-V bundle into the ventricles. Except for the initial portion of these fibers, where they penetrate the A-V fibrous barrier, they have functional characteristics that are the opposite of those of the A-V nodal fibers. They are very large fibers, even larger than the normal ventricu lar muscle fibers, and they transmit action potentials at a velocity of 1.5 to 4.0 m/sec, a velocity about six times that in the usual ventricular muscle and 150 times that in some of the A-V nodal fibers. This velocity allows almost instan taneous transmission of the cardiac impulse throughout the entire remainder of the ventricular muscle.

The rapid transmission of action potentials by Pur kinje fibers is believed to be caused by a very high level of permeability of the gap junctions at the intercalated discs between the successive cells that make up the Purkinje fibers. Therefore, ions are transmitted easily from one cell to the next, thus enhancing the velocity of transmission. The Purkinje fibers also have very few myofibrils, which means that they contract little or not at all during the course of impulse transmission.

A special characteristic of the A-V bundle is the inability, except in abnormal states, of action potentials to travel backward from the ventricles to the atria. This characteristic prevents re-entry of cardiac impulses by this route from the ventricles to the atria, allowing only forward conduction from the atria to the ventricles.
full.lead: The A-V Bundle Is Normally a One-Way Conduction Path.

full.text: Furthermore, it should be recalled that everywhere, except at the A-V bundle, the atrial muscle is separated from the ventricular muscle by a continuous fibrous bar rier, a portion of which is shown in **Figure 10-3**. This barrier normally acts as an insulator to prevent passage of the cardiac impulse between atrial and ventricular muscle through any other route besides forward conduc tion through the A-V bundle. In rare cases, an abnormal muscle bridge, or accessory pathway, does penetrate the fibrous barrier elsewhere besides at the A-V bundle. Under such conditions, the cardiac impulse can re-enter the atria from the ventricles and cause serious cardiac arrhythmias.

After penetrating the fibrous tissue between the atrial and ventricular muscle, the distal portion of the A-V bundle passes downward in the ven tricular septum for 5 to 15 mm toward the apex of the heart, as shown in **Figures 10-1** and **10-3**. Then, the bundle divides into left and right bundle branches that lie beneath the endo cardium on the two respective sides of the ventricular sep tum. Each branch spreads downward toward the apex of the ventricle, progressively dividing into smaller branches. These branches, in turn, course sidewise around each ventricular chamber and back toward the base of the heart. The ends of the Purkinje fibers penetrate about one-third of the way into the muscle mass and finally become continuous with the car diac muscle fibers.
full.lead: Distribution of the Purkinje Fibers in the Ventricles—Left and Right Bundle Branches.

full.text: The total elapsed time averages only 0.03 second from the time the cardiac impulse enters the bundle branches in the ventricular septum until it reaches the termina tions of the Purkinje fibers. Therefore, once the cardiac impulse enters the ventricular Purkinje conductive sys tem, it spreads almost immediately to the entire ventricu lar muscle mass.
TRANSMISSION OF THE CARDIAC IMPULSE IN THE VENTRICULAR MUSCLE

Once the impulse reaches the ends of the Purkinje fibers, it is transmitted through the ventricular muscle mass by the ventricular muscle fibers themselves. The velocity of transmission is now only 0.3 to 0.5 m/sec, one-sixth that in the Purkinje fibers.

The cardiac muscle wraps around the heart in a double spiral, with fibrous septa between the spiraling layers; there fore, the cardiac impulse does not necessarily travel directly outward toward the surface of the heart but, instead, angu lates toward the surface along the directions of the spirals. Because of this angulation, transmission from the endocardial surface to the epicardial surface of the ventricle requires as much as another 0.03 second, approximately equal to the time required for transmission through the entire ventricular por tion of the Purkinje system. Thus, the total time for transmis sion of the cardiac impulse from the initial bundle branches to the last of the ventricular muscle fibers in the normal heart is about 0.06 second.
SUMMARY OF THE SPREAD OF THE CARDIAC IMPULSE THROUGH THE HEART

**Figure 10-4** summarizes the transmission of the cardiac impulse through the human heart. The numbers on the figure represent the intervals of time, in fractions of a sec ond, that lapse between the origin of the cardiac impulse in the sinus node and its appearance at each respective point in the heart. Note that the impulse spreads at mod erate velocity through the atria but is delayed more than 0.1 second in the A-V nodal region before appearing in the ventricular septal A-V bundle. Once it has entered this bundle, it spreads very rapidly through the Purkinje fibers to the entire endocardial surfaces of the ventricles. Then, the impulse once again spreads slightly less rapidly through the ventricular muscle to the epicardial surfaces.

It is important that the student learn in detail the course of the cardiac impulse through the heart and the precise times of its appearance in each separate part of the heart. A thorough quantitative knowledge of this process is essential for understanding electrocardiography, which is discussed in Chapters 11 through 13.
CONTROL OF EXCITATION AND CONDUCTION IN THE HEART
THE SINUS NODE IS THE NORMAL PACE MAKER OF THE HEART

In discussing the genesis and transmission of the cardiac impulse through the heart, we have noted that the impulse normally arises in the sinus node. In some abnormal con ditions, this is not the case. Other parts of the heart can also exhibit intrinsic rhythmical excitation in the same way as the sinus nodal fibers; this is particularly true of the A-V nodal and Purkinje fibers.

The A-V nodal fibers, when not stimulated from some outside source, discharge at an intrinsic rhythmical rate of 40 to 60 times per minute, and the Purkinje fibers dis charge at a rate somewhere between 15 and 40 times per minute. These rates are in contrast to the normal rate of the sinus node of 70 to 80 times per minute.

Why then does the sinus node rather than the A-V node or the Purkinje fibers control the heart’s rhythmic ity? The answer derives from the fact that the discharge rate of the sinus node is considerably faster than the natu ral self-excitatory discharge rate of either the A-V node or the Purkinje fibers. Each time the sinus node discharges, its impulse is conducted into both the A-V node and Purkinje fibers, also discharging their excitable membranes. How ever, the sinus node discharges again before either the A-V node or Purkinje fibers can reach their own thresholds for self-excitation. Therefore, the new impulse from the sinus node discharges both the A-V node and Purkinje fibers before self-excitation can occur in either of these sites.

Thus, the sinus node controls the beat of the heart because its rate of rhythmical discharge is faster than that of any other part of the heart. Therefore, the sinus node is almost always the pacemaker of the normal heart.

Occasio nally, some other part of the heart develops a rhythmical discharge rate that is more rapid than that of the sinus node. For example, this development sometimes occurs in the A-V node or in the Purkinje fibers when one of these becomes abnormal. In either case, the pacemaker of the heart shifts from the sinus node to the A-V node or to the excited Purkinje fibers. Under rarer conditions, a place in the atrial or ventricular muscle develops excessive excit ability and becomes the pacemaker.

A pacemaker elsewhere than the sinus node is called an _ectopic pacemaker_. An ectopic pacemaker causes an abnormal sequence of contraction of the different parts of the heart and can cause significant weakening of heart pumping.

Another cause of shift of the pacemaker is blockage of transmission of the cardiac impulse from the sinus node to the other parts of the heart. The new pacemaker then usually occurs at the A-V node or in the penetrating por tion of the A-V bundle on the way to the ventricles.

When A-V block occurs—that is, when the cardiac impulse fails to pass from the atria into the ventricles through the A-V nodal and bundle system—the atria con tinue to beat at the normal rate of rhythm of the sinus node while a new pacemaker usually develops in the Pur kinje system of the ventricles and drives the ventricular muscle at a new rate, somewhere between 15 and 40 beats per minute. After sudden A-V bundle block, the Purkinje system does not begin to emit its intrinsic rhythmical impulses until 5 to 20 seconds later because, before the blockage, the Purkinje fibers had been “overdriven” by the rapid sinus impulses and, consequently, are in a sup pressed state. During these 5 to 20 seconds, the ventricles fail to pump blood, and the person faints after the first 4 to 5 seconds because of lack of blood flow to the brain. This delayed pickup of the heartbeat is called _StokesAdams syndrome_. If the delay period is too long, it can lead to death.
ROLE OF THE PURKINJE SYSTEM IN CAUSING SYNCHRONOUS CONTRACTION OF THE VENTRICULAR MUSCLE

The rapid conduction of the Purkinje system normally permits the cardiac impulse to arrive at almost all por tions of the ventricles within a narrow span of time, excit ing the first ventricular muscle fiber only 0.03 to 0.06 second ahead of excitation of the last ventricular muscle fiber. This timing causes all portions of the ventricular muscle in both ventricles to begin contracting at almost the same time and then to continue contracting for about another 0.3 second.

Effective pumping by the two ventricular chambers requires this synchronous type of contraction. If the car diac impulse should travel through the ventricles slowly, much of the ventricular mass would contract before contraction of the remainder, in which case the overall pumping effect would be greatly depressed. Indeed, in some types of cardiac dysfunction, several of which are discussed in Chapters 12 and 13, slow transmission does occur, and the pumping effectiveness of the ventricles is decreased as much as 20% to 30%. Implantable cardiac resynchronization devices are types of pacemakers using electrical wires or leads that can be inserted into the car diac chambers to restore appropriate timing between the atria and both ventricles to improve pumping effective ness in patients with enlarged and weakened hearts.
SYMPATHETIC AND PARASYMPATHETIC NERVES CONTROL HEART RHYTHMICITY AND IMPULSE CONDUCTION BY THE CARDIAC NERVES

The heart is supplied with both sympathetic and para sympathetic nerves, as shown in **Figure 9-14** of Chapter 9. The parasympathetic nerves (the vagi) are distributed mainly to the S-A and A-V nodes, to a lesser extent to the muscle of the two atria, and very little directly to the ventricular muscle. The sympathetic nerves, conversely, are distributed to all parts of the heart, with strong rep resentation in the ventricular muscle, as well as in all the other areas.

Stimulation of the parasym pathetic nerves to the heart (the vagi) causes _acetylcholine_ to be released at the vagal endings. This neurotransmitter has two major effects on the heart. First, it decreases the rate of rhythm of the sinus node, and second, it decreases the excitability of the A-V junctional fibers between the atrial musculature and the A-V node, thereby slowing transmission of the cardiac impulse into the ventricles.
full.lead: Parasympathetic (Vagal) Stimulation Slows the Cardiac Rhythm and Conduction.

full.text: Weak to moderate vagal stimulation slows the rate of heart pumping, often to as little as one-half normal. Fur thermore, strong stimulation of the vagi can completely stop the rhythmical excitation by the sinus node or com pletely block transmission of the cardiac impulse from the atria into the ventricles through the A-V node. In either case, rhythmical excitatory signals are no longer transmit ted into the ventricles. The ventricles may stop beating for 5 to 20 seconds, but then some small area in the Purkinje fibers, usually in the ventricular septal portion of the A-V bundle, develops a rhythm of its own and causes ventricu lar contraction at a rate of 15 to 40 beats per minute. This phenomenon is called _ventricular escape_.

The acetylcholine re leased at the vagal nerve endings greatly increases the per meability of the fiber membranes to potassium ions, which allows rapid leakage of potassium out of the conductive fib ers. This process causes increased negativity inside the fibers, an effect called _hyperpolarization,_ which makes this excitable tissue much less excitable, as explained in Chapter 5.
In the sinus node, the state of hyperpolarization makes the resting membrane potential of the sinus nodal fibers considerably more negative than usual—that is, −65 to

−75 millivolts rather than the normal level of −55 to −60 millivolts. Therefore, the initial rise of the sinus nodal membrane potential caused by inward sodium and cal cium leakage requires much longer to reach the threshold potential for excitation. This requirement greatly slows the rate of rhythmicity of these nodal fibers. If the vagal stimulation is strong enough, it is possible to stop the rhythmical self-excitation of this node entirely.

In the A-V node, a state of hyperpolarization caused by vagal stimulation makes it difficult for the small atrial fibers entering the node to generate enough electricity to excite the nodal fibers. Therefore, the safety factor for transmission of the cardiac impulse through the transi tional fibers into the A-V nodal fibers decreases. A mod erate decrease simply delays conduction of the impulse, but a large decrease blocks conduction entirely.

Sympathetic stimulation causes essentially the opposite effects on the heart as those caused by vagal stimulation, as follows. 1. It increases the rate of sinus nodal discharge. 2. It increases the rate of conduction, as well as the level of excitability in all portions of the heart. 3. It increases greatly the force of contraction of all the cardiac musculature, both atrial and ventricular, as discussed in Chapter 9. In short, sympathetic stimulation increases the overall activity of the heart. Maximal stimulation can almost tri ple the heartbeat frequency and can increase the strength of heart contraction as much as twofold.
full.lead: Sympathetic Stimulation Increases the Cardiac Rhythm and Conduction.

full.text: Stimulation of the sympathetic nerves releases _norepinephrine_ at the sympathetic nerve endings. Norepinephrine, in turn, stimulates _beta-1 adrenergic receptors_, which mediate the effects on heart rate. The precise mechanism whereby be ta-1 adrenergic stimulation acts on cardiac muscle fibers is somewhat unclear, but is thought to increase the per meability of the fiber membrane to sodium and calcium ions. In the sinus node, an increase of sodium-calcium permeability causes a more positive resting potential. It also causes an increased rate of upward drift of the di astolic membrane potential toward the threshold level for self-excitation, thus accelerating self-excitation and, therefore, increasing the heart rate.

In the A-V node and A-V bundles, increased sodiumcalcium permeability makes it easier for the action poten tial to excite each succeeding portion of the conducting fiber bundles, thereby decreasing the conduction time from the atria to the ventricles.

The increase in permeability to calcium ions is at least partially responsible for the increase in contractile strength of the cardiac muscle under the influence of sympathetic stimulation. This is because calcium ions play a powerful role in exciting the contractile process of the myofibrils.

The fibers of this node have almost no contractile muscle filaments and are each only 3 to 5 micrometers (μm) in diameter, in contrast to a diameter of 10 to 15 μm for the surrounding atrial muscle fibers
Note that the resting membrane potential of the sinus nodal fiber between discharges is about –55 to –60 millivolts, in comparison with –85 to –90 millivolts for the ventricular muscle fiber

However, there is a difference in the function of these channels in the sinus nodal fiber because the resting potential is much less negative—only –55 millivolts in the nodal fiber instead of the –90 millivolts in the ventricular muscle fiber
At this level of –55 millivolts, the fast sodium channels mainly have already become inactivated, or blocked

ch10-f3.text: **Rasm 10-1** da yurak qisqarişlarini boşqaruvçi maxsus qözğatuvçi va ötkazuvçi tizim körsatilgan. Rasmda quyidagilar bor: me’yoriy ritmik impulslar hosil böladigan sinus tuguni (sinoatrial [S-A] tugun deb ham ataladi); impulslarni sinus tugunidan atrioventrikulyar (A-V) tugunga ötkazuvçi tugunlararo yöllar; bölmaçalardan kelgan impulslar qorinçalarga ötişidan oldin keçiktiriladigan A-V tugun; impulslarni bölmaçalardan qorinçalarga ötkazuvçi A-V tutam; yurak impulslarini qorinçalarning barça qismlariga yetkazuvçi Purkinye tolalaridan iborat çap va öng tutam oyoqçalari.

ch10-f6.text: Sinus tuguni — taxminan 3 mm eni, 15 mm uzunligi va 1 mm qalinligidagi maxsus yurak muskulidan taşkil topgan kiçik, yassi, ellipssimon tasma. U öng bölmaçaning yuqori orqa-yon devorida, yuqori kovak vena oğzidan bevosita pastda va biroz lateralroqda joylaşgan. Bu tugun tolalarida qisqaruvçi muskul iplari deyarli yöq va har birining diametri atigi 3–5 mikrometr (µm); atrofdagi bölmaça muskul tolalarining diametri esa 10–15 µm. Biroq sinus tuguni tolalari bölmaça muskul tolalari bilan bevosita tutaşgan, şuning uçun sinus tugunida boşlangan har qanday harakat potensiali darhol bölmaça muskul devoriga tarqaladi.

ch10-f8.text: Ba’zi yurak tolalari _öz-özini qözğatiş_ qobiliyatiga ega; bu jarayon avtomatik ritmik razryad va qisqarişni keltirib çiqarişi mumkin. Bu qobiliyat ayniqsa yurakning maxsus ötkazuvçi tizimiga, jumladan sinus tuguni tolalariga xos. Şu sababli, bobning keyingi qismida batafsil muhokama qilinganidek, odatda butun yurakning uriş tezligini sinus tuguni boşqaradi. Avval şu avtomatik ritmiklikni tavsiflaymiz.

ch10-f9.text: **Rasm 10-2** da sinus tuguni tolasi içidan uçta yurak urişi davomida yozib olingan harakat potensiallari va taqqoslaş uçun qorinça muskul tolasining bitta harakat potensiali körsatilgan. E’tibor bering: razryadlar orasida sinus tuguni tolasining tinçlik membrana potensiali taxminan –55 dan –60 millivoltgaça, qorinça muskul tolasida esa –85 dan –90 millivoltgaça. Manfiylikning bunday pastroq bölişiga sabab — sinus tolalari hujayra membranalarining natriy va kalsiy ionlarini tabiiy ravişda “ötkazib yuborişi” (sizdirişi): kirib kelayotgan natriy va kalsiy ionlarining musbat zaryadlari hujayra içidagi manfiylikning bir qismini neytrallaydi.

ch10-f10.text: Sinus tuguni tolalarining ritmikligini tuşuntirişdan oldin, 5- va 9-boblardagi muhokamani eslaylik: yurak muskulida harakat potensialidagi kuçlaniş özgarişlarini keltirib çiqarişda muhim rol öynaydigan uç asosiy turdagi membrana ion kanallari bor. Ular: (1) _tez natriy kanallari_, (2) _kalsiy kanallari (ayniqsa L-tipli_ yoki _“sekin” kalsiy kanallari)_ va (3) _kaliy kanallari_ (qarang: **Rasm 9-5**).

ch10-f11.text: Tez natriy kanallarining sekundning bir neça ön mingdan bir uluşi davomida oçilişi qorinça muskulida kuzatiladigan harakat potensialining tez kötariluvçi çöqqisiga sabab böladi, çunki musbat natriy ionlari tola içiga tez kiradi. Söngra qorinça harakat potensialining platosi asosan sekin natriy-kalsiy kanallarining sekinroq oçilişidan kelib çiqadi va taxminan 0,3 soniya davom etadi. Nihoyat, kaliy kanallarining oçilişi köp miqdordagi musbat kaliy ionlarining tola membranasi orqali taşqariga diffuziyalanişiga imkon beradi va membrana potensialini tinçlik darajasiga qaytaradi.

ch10-f12.text: Biroq sinus tuguni tolasida bu kanallarning işlaşida farq bor, çunki tinçlik potensiali ança kam manfiy — qorinça muskul tolasidagi –90 millivolt örniga tugun tolasida atigi –55 millivolt. –55 millivolt darajasida tez natriy kanallari asosan allaqaçon inaktivatsiyalangan, ya’ni yopilib qolgan böladi. Sababi: membrana potensiali bir neça millisekunddan uzoqroq vaqt davomida taxminan –55 millivoltdan kamroq manfiy bölib tursa, hujayra membranasining içki tomonidagi tez natriy kanallarini yopuvçi inaktivatsiya darvozalari yopiladi va şu holatda qoladi. Şuning uçun faqat sekin natriy-kalsiy kanallari oçilişi (ya’ni faollaşişi) va şu orqali harakat potensialini yuzaga keltirişi mumkin. Natijada bölmaça tugunining harakat potensiali qorinça muskulining harakat potensialiga qaraganda sekinroq rivojlanadi. Şuningdek, harakat potensiali yuzaga kelgandan keyin potensialning manfiy holatga qaytişi ham qorinça tolasidagi kabi keskin emas, balki sekin sodir böladi.

ch10-f13.text: Tugun tolasi taşqarisidagi hujayradan taşqari suyuqlikda natriy ionlari konsentratsiyasi yuqori bölgani, şuningdek, allaqaçon oçiq turgan natriy kanallarining örtaça soni tufayli taşqaridagi musbat natriy ionlari odatda içkariga yönalgan “ğalati” (funny) oqimlar orqali tola içiga sizib kirişga intiladi. Şu sababli yurak urişlari oraliğida musbat zaryadli natriy ionlarining kirib kelişi tinçlik membrana potensialini musbat tomonga sekin kötaradi. Şunday qilib, **Rasm 10-2** da körsatilganidek, har ikki yurak urişi oraliğida tinçlik potensiali asta-sekin kötarilib, kamroq manfiy bölib boradi. Demak, mohiyatan sinus tuguni tolalarining natriy va kalsiy ionlarini tabiiy ravişda ötkazib yuborişi ularning öz-özini qözğatişiga sabab böladi.
ch10-f13.lead: Sinus tuguni tolalarining natriy va kalsiyni ötkazib yuborişi öz-özini qözğatişga sabab böladi.

ch10-f15.text: Nima uçun natriy va kalsiy ionlarining bunday sizib kirişi sinus tuguni tolalarini doimo depolyarizatsiyalangan holatda uşlab turmaydi? Harakat potensiali davomida bunday doimiy depolyarizatsiyaning oldini oluvçi ikki hodisa röy beradi. Birinçidan, L-tipli kalsiy kanallari oçilgandan keyin taxminan 100–150 millisekund içida inaktivatsiyalanadi (ya’ni yopiladi); ikkinçidan, deyarli şu vaqtda kaliy kanallarining juda köp soni oçiladi. Şu sababli musbat kalsiy va natriy ionlarining L-tipli kalsiy kanallari orqali kirişi töxtaydi, ayni paytda katta miqdordagi musbat kaliy ionlari toladan taşqariga diffuziyalanadi. Bu ikki ta’sir hujayra içidagi potensialni yana manfiy tinçlik darajasiga tuşiradi va harakat potensialini yakunlaydi. Bundan taşqari, kaliy kanallari yana sekundning bir neça öndan bir uluşi davomida oçiq qoladi, musbat zaryadlarning hujayradan taşqariga çiqişi vaqtinça davom etadi va natijada tola içida ortiqça manfiylik yuzaga keladi; bu jarayon _giperpolyarizatsiya_ deb ataladi. Giperpolyarizatsiya holati harakat potensiali tugaşi bilan dastlab tinçlik membrana potensialini taxminan –55 dan –60 millivoltgaça tuşiradi.

ch10-f16.text: Nima uçun bu yangi giperpolyarizatsiya holati abadiy saqlanib qolmaydi? Sababi şuki, harakat potensiali tugaganidan keyingi sekundning bir neça öndan bir uluşi davomida kaliy kanallari tobora köproq yopiladi. Içkariga sizib kirayotgan natriy (“ğalati” oqim) va kalsiy ionlari yana kaliy ionlarining taşqariga çiqişidan ustun keladi; bu tinçlik potensialini yana yuqoriga siljitadi va oxir-oqibat taxminan –40 millivoltda razryad uçun bösağa darajasiga yetkazadi. Keyin butun jarayon qaytadan boşlanadi: harakat potensialini keltirib çiqaruvçi öz-özini qözğatiş, harakat potensialidan tiklaniş, harakat potensiali tugagaç giperpolyarizatsiya, tinçlik potensialining bösağagaça siljişi va nihoyat yangi siklni boşlovçi qayta qözğaliş. Bu jarayon inson umri davomida töxtovsiz davom etadi.

ch10-f17.text: Tugunlararo va bölmaçalararo yöllar yurak impulslarini bölmaçalar böylab ötkazadi

ch10-f18.text: Sinus tuguni tolalarining uçlari atrofdagi bölmaça muskul tolalari bilan bevosita tutaşgan. Şuning uçun sinus tugunida boşlangan harakat potensiallari taşqariga, şu bölmaça muskul tolalariga tarqaladi. Şu yöl bilan harakat potensiali butun bölmaça muskul massasiga va oxir-oqibat A-V tugunga yetib boradi. Bölmaça muskulining katta qismida ötkaziş tezligi taxminan 0,3 m/s, biroq bölmaça tolalaridan iborat bir neçta kiçik tasmalarda ötkaziş tezroq — taxminan 1 m/s. Ana şunday tasmalardan biri — _oldingi bölmaçalararo tasma_ (_Baxman tutami_ deb ham ataladi) — bölmaçalarning oldingi devorlari orqali çap bölmaçaga ötadi. Bundan taşqari, yana uçta kiçik tasma bölmaçalarning oldingi, yon va orqa devorlari böylab egilib ötib, A-V tugunda tugaydi (**Rasm 10-1** va **Rasm 10-3**); ular mos ravişda _oldingi, örta_ va _orqa tugunlararo yöllar_ deb ataladi. Bu tasmalarda ötkaziş tezligining yuqoriroq bölişiga sabab — ularda maxsus ötkazuvçi tolalar mavjudligi. Bu tolalar quyida muhokama qilinadigan, impulsni yanada tezroq ötkazadigan qorinçalardagi Purkinye tolalariga öxşaydi.

ch10-f20.text: Atrioventrikulyar tugun impulsning bölmaçalardan qorinçalarga ötişini keçiktiradi

ch10-f21.text: Bölmaçalarning ötkazuvçi tizimi şunday tuzilganki, yurak impulsi bölmaçalardan qorinçalarga juda tez ötib ketmaydi; bu keçikiş qorinçalar qisqarişi boşlanişidan oldin bölmaçalarga qonni qorinçalarga böşatişi uçun vaqt beradi. Qorinçalarga ötkazişni asosan A-V tugun va unga qöşni ötkazuvçi tolalar keçiktiradi.

ch10-f22.text: **Rasm 10-1** da körsatilganidek, A-V tugun öng bölmaçaning orqa devorida, uç tavaqali klapandan bevosita orqada joylaşgan. **Rasm 10-3** da bu tugunning turli qismlari, şuningdek, unga kiruvçi bölmaça tugunlararo yöl tolalari va undan çiquvçi A-V tutam bilan boğlanişlari sxematik tasvirlangan. Bu rasmda, şuningdek, yurak impulsi sinus tugunida boşlangan paytdan A-V tugun tizimida paydo bölguniça ötadigan taxminiy vaqt oraliqlari (sekund uluşlarida) körsatilgan. E’tibor bering: impuls tugunlararo yöllar orqali ötib, sinus tugunida paydo bölganidan taxminan 0,03 soniya ötgaç A-V tugunga yetadi. Söngra impuls qorinçalarga ötadigan A-V tutamning teşib ötuvçi qismiga kirişidan oldin A-V tugunning özida yana 0,09 soniya keçikadi. Yana 0,04 soniyalik oxirgi keçikiş asosan şu teşib ötuvçi A-V tutamda sodir böladi; bu tutam bölmaçalarni qorinçalardan ajratib turuvçi fibroz töqima orqali ötadigan köplab mayda dastalardan iborat.

ch10-f23.text: Şunday qilib, A-V tugun va A-V tutam tizimidagi umumiy keçikiş taxminan 0,13 soniyani taşkil etadi. Bu keçikiş sinus tugunidan A-V tugungaça bölgan dastlabki 0,03 soniyalik ötkaziş keçikişi bilan qöşilib, qözğatuvçi signal qorinçalarning qisqaruvçi muskuliga yetib borguniga qadar jami 0,16 soniyalik keçikişni hosil qiladi.

ch10-f24.text: Ötiş (tranzitor) tolalari, tugun tolalari va teşib ötuvçi A-V tutam tolalarida ötkazişning sekinligi asosan ötkazuvçi yöllardagi ketma-ket hujayralar orasidagi tirqişli birikmalar (gap junctions) sonining kamligi bilan boğliq; şu sababli qözğatuvçi ionlarning bir ötkazuvçi toladan keyingisiga ötişiga katta qarşilik böladi. Şuning uçun har bir keyingi hujayra nima sababdan sekin qözğalişini tuşuniş oson.

ch10-f25.text: Qorinçalardagi Purkinye tizimida yurak impulsining tez ötkazilişi

ch10-f26.text: Maxsus Purkinye tolalari A-V tugundan A-V tutam orqali qorinçalarga boradi. Bu tolalarning A-V fibroz tösiqni teşib ötadigan dastlabki qismidan taşqari, ularning funksional xususiyatlari A-V tugun tolalarinikiga mutlaqo teskari. Ular juda yöğon tolalar — hatto oddiy qorinça muskul tolalaridan ham yöğonroq — va harakat potensiallarini 1,5–4,0 m/s tezlikda ötkazadi; bu oddiy qorinça muskulidagidan taxminan olti marta, ba’zi A-V tugun tolalaridagidan esa 150 marta tezroq. Bunday tezlik yurak impulsining qorinça muskulining qolgan butun qismiga deyarli bir zumda tarqalişiga imkon beradi.

ch10-f27.text: Purkinye tolalarida harakat potensiallarining tez ötkazilişiga Purkinye tolalarini taşkil etuvçi ketma-ket hujayralar orasidagi interkalyar disklardagi tirqişli birikmalarning juda yuqori ötkazuvçanligi sabab böladi, deb hisoblanadi. Şuning uçun ionlar bir hujayradan keyingisiga oson ötadi va bu ötkaziş tezligini oşiradi. Purkinye tolalarida miofibrillar ham juda kam; bu ular impuls ötkaziş davomida juda kam qisqarişini yoki umuman qisqarmasligini bildiradi.

ch10-f28.text: A-V tutamning öziga xos xususiyati şundaki, ğayritabiiy holatlardan taşqari, harakat potensiallari u orqali qorinçalardan bölmaçalarga orqaga qarab tarqala olmaydi. Bu xususiyat yurak impulslarining şu yöl orqali qorinçalardan bölmaçalarga qayta kirişining (re-entry) oldini oladi va faqat bölmaçalardan qorinçalarga oldinga yönalgan ötkazişga imkon beradi.
ch10-f28.lead: A-V tutam odatda bir tomonlama ötkazuvçi yöl.

ch10-f29.text: Bundan taşqari, şuni eslaş kerakki, A-V tutamdan boşqa barça joylarda bölmaça muskuli qorinça muskulidan uzluksiz fibroz tösiq bilan ajratilgan; uning bir qismi **Rasm 10-3** da körsatilgan. Bu tösiq odatda izolyator vazifasini bajaradi va yurak impulsining bölmaça va qorinça muskullari orasida A-V tutam orqali oldinga ötişdan boşqa har qanday yöl bilan ötişiga yöl qöymaydi. Kamdan-kam hollarda ğayritabiiy muskul köprigi yoki qöşimça (akssessor) yöl fibroz tösiqni A-V tutamdan boşqa joyda teşib ötadi. Bunday şaroitda yurak impulsi qorinçalardan bölmaçalarga qayta kirişi va jiddiy yurak aritmiyalarini keltirib çiqarişi mumkin.

ch10-f30.text: Bölmaça va qorinça muskullari orasidagi fibroz töqimani teşib ötgaç, A-V tutamning distal qismi qorinçalararo tösiqda yurak çöqqisi tomon 5–15 mm pastga tuşadi (**Rasm 10-1** va **Rasm 10-3**). Söngra tutam çap va öng oyoqçalarga bölinadi; ular qorinçalararo tösiqning tegişli ikki tomonida endokard ostida yotadi. Har bir oyoqça qorinça çöqqisi tomon pastga tarqalib, asta-sekin mayda şoxçalarga bölinib boradi. Bu şoxçalar öz navbatida har bir qorinça böşliği atrofida yon tomonga aylanib, yurak asosi tomon qaytadi. Purkinye tolalarining uçlari muskul massasining taxminan uçdan bir qismigaça kirib boradi va nihoyat yurak muskul tolalari bilan uzluksiz davom etadi.
ch10-f30.lead: Purkinye tolalarining qorinçalarda tarqalişi — çap va öng tutam oyoqçalari.

ch10-f31.text: Yurak impulsi qorinçalararo tösiqdagi tutam oyoqçalariga kirgan paytdan Purkinye tolalarining uçlariga yetguniça ötadigan umumiy vaqt örtaça atigi 0,03 soniya. Şu sababli yurak impulsi qorinçalarning Purkinye ötkazuvçi tizimiga kirgaç, deyarli darhol butun qorinça muskul massasiga tarqaladi.

ch10-f33.text: Impuls Purkinye tolalarining uçlariga yetgaç, u qorinça muskul massasi böylab qorinça muskul tolalarining özi orqali ötkaziladi. Endi ötkaziş tezligi atigi 0,3–0,5 m/s, ya’ni Purkinye tolalaridagining oltidan bir qismi.

ch10-f34.text: Yurak muskuli yurakni qöş spiral şaklida örab oladi, spiral qatlamlar orasida fibroz tösiqlar bor; şu sababli yurak impulsi yurak yuzasi tomon töğridan-töğri taşqariga emas, balki spirallar yönalişi böylab yuza tomon qiya burçak ostida tarqaladi. Bunday qiyalik tufayli qorinçaning endokard yuzasidan epikard yuzasigaça ötkaziş yana 0,03 soniyagaça vaqt talab qiladi; bu Purkinye tizimining butun qorinça qismi orqali ötkaziş uçun ketadigan vaqtga taxminan teng. Şunday qilib, soğlom yurakda yurak impulsining dastlabki tutam oyoqçalaridan oxirgi qorinça muskul tolalarigaça ötkazilişi uçun umumiy vaqt taxminan 0,06 soniya.

ch10-f35.text: Yurak impulsining yurak böylab tarqalişi: xulosa

ch10-f36.text: **Rasm 10-4** da yurak impulsining inson yuragi böylab ötkazilişi umumlaştirilgan. Rasmdagi raqamlar yurak impulsi sinus tugunida paydo bölgan paytdan yurakning har bir tegişli nuqtasida paydo bölguniça ötadigan vaqt oraliqlarini (sekund uluşlarida) bildiradi. E’tibor bering: impuls bölmaçalar böylab örtaça tezlikda tarqaladi, biroq qorinçalararo tösiqdagi A-V tutamda paydo bölişidan oldin A-V tugun sohasida 0,1 soniyadan köproq keçikadi. Bu tutamga kirgaç, u Purkinye tolalari orqali qorinçalarning butun endokard yuzasiga juda tez tarqaladi. Söngra impuls yana biroz sekinroq tezlikda qorinça muskuli orqali epikard yuzalariga tarqaladi.

ch10-f38.text: Talaba yurak impulsining yurak böylab yölini va uning yurakning har bir alohida qismida paydo böliş vaqtlarini batafsil örganişi muhim. Bu jarayonni çuqur, miqdoriy biliş 11–13-boblarda muhokama qilinadigan elektrokardiografiyani tuşuniş uçun zarur.

ch10-f40.text: Sinus tuguni — yurakning me’yoriy ritm yetakçisi (pacemaker)

ch10-f41.text: Yurak impulsining hosil bölişi va yurak böylab ötkazilişini muhokama qilganda biz impuls odatda sinus tugunida paydo bölişini qayd etdik. Ba’zi ğayritabiiy holatlarda bunday bölmaydi. Yurakning boşqa qismlari ham sinus tuguni tolalari kabi içki ritmik qözğalişni namoyon qilişi mumkin; bu ayniqsa A-V tugun va Purkinye tolalariga xos.

ch10-f42.text: A-V tugun tolalari taşqi manbadan qözğatilmaganda daqiqasiga 40–60 marta içki ritmik tezlikda razryadlanadi, Purkinye tolalari esa daqiqasiga taxminan 15–40 marta razryadlanadi. Sinus tugunining me’yoriy tezligi esa daqiqasiga 70–80 marta.

ch10-f43.text: Unda nima uçun yurak ritmikligini A-V tugun yoki Purkinye tolalari emas, balki sinus tuguni boşqaradi? Javob şundaki, sinus tugunining razryad tezligi A-V tugun yoki Purkinye tolalarining tabiiy öz-özini qözğatiş tezligidan ança yuqori. Sinus tuguni har safar razryadlanganda uning impulsi A-V tugunga ham, Purkinye tolalariga ham ötkaziladi va ularning qözğaluvçan membranalarini ham razryadlaydi. Biroq A-V tugun ham, Purkinye tolalari ham öz-özini qözğatiş bösağasiga yetişidan oldin sinus tuguni yana razryadlanadi. Şu sababli bu joylarning birortasida öz-özini qözğatiş yuz berişidan oldin sinus tugunidan kelgan yangi impuls A-V tugunni ham, Purkinye tolalarini ham razryadlaydi.

ch10-f44.text: Şunday qilib, sinus tuguni yurak urişini boşqaradi, çunki uning ritmik razryad tezligi yurakning boşqa har qanday qismidagidan yuqori. Şuning uçun soğlom yurakda ritm yetakçisi deyarli har doim sinus tuguni böladi.

ch10-f45.text: Ba’zan yurakning boşqa bir qismida sinus tugunidagidan tezroq ritmik razryad tezligi rivojlanadi. Masalan, bu holat ba’zan A-V tugunda yoki Purkinye tolalarida, ulardan biri ğayritabiiy holatga kelganda yuz beradi. Har ikki holatda ham yurakning ritm yetakçisi sinus tugunidan A-V tugunga yoki qözğalgan Purkinye tolalariga köçadi. Kamroq uçraydigan holatlarda bölmaça yoki qorinça muskulidagi biror joyda haddan taşqari qözğaluvçanlik rivojlanib, u ritm yetakçisiga aylanadi.

ch10-f46.text: Sinus tugunidan boşqa joydagi ritm yetakçisi _ektopik pacemaker_ deb ataladi. Ektopik pacemaker yurakning turli qismlari qisqarişining ğayritabiiy ketma-ketligiga sabab böladi va yurakning nasos faoliyatini sezilarli darajada susaytirişi mumkin.

ch10-f47.text: Ritm yetakçisi köçişining yana bir sababi — yurak impulsining sinus tugunidan yurakning boşqa qismlariga ötkazilişining tösilişi (blokadasi). Bunda yangi ritm yetakçisi odatda A-V tugunda yoki A-V tutamning qorinçalarga boruvçi teşib ötuvçi qismida paydo böladi.

ch10-f48.text: A-V blokada yuz berganda — ya’ni yurak impulsi bölmaçalardan qorinçalarga A-V tugun va tutam tizimi orqali öta olmaganda — bölmaçalar sinus tugunining me’yoriy ritmi bilan urişda davom etadi, qorinçalarning Purkinye tizimida esa odatda yangi ritm yetakçisi rivojlanadi va qorinça muskulini daqiqasiga 15–40 marta oraliğidagi yangi tezlikda qisqartiradi. A-V tutam tösatdan blokadalangandan keyin Purkinye tizimi özining içki ritmik impulslarini faqat 5–20 soniyadan söng çiqara boşlaydi, çunki blokadagaça Purkinye tolalari tez sinus impulslari bilan “bostirib” (overdrive) turilgan va şu sababli susaygan holatda böladi. Şu 5–20 soniya davomida qorinçalar qon haydamaydi va miyaga qon oqimi yetişmasligi tufayli odam dastlabki 4–5 soniyadan keyin huşini yöqotadi. Yurak urişining bunday keçikib tiklanişi _Stoks–Adams sindromi_ deb ataladi. Agar keçikiş davri juda uzoq bölsa, ölimga olib kelişi mumkin.

ch10-f49.text: Purkinye tizimining qorinça muskulini sinxron qisqartirişdagi roli

ch10-f50.text: Purkinye tizimining tez ötkazuvçanligi odatda yurak impulsining qorinçalarning deyarli barça qismlariga qisqa vaqt oraliğida yetib borişini ta’minlaydi: birinçi qorinça muskul tolasi oxirgi qorinça muskul tolasidan atigi 0,03–0,06 soniya oldin qözğaladi. Bunday vaqt muvofiqligi ikkala qorinçadagi qorinça muskulining barça qismlari deyarli bir vaqtda qisqarişni boşlaşiga va söngra yana taxminan 0,3 soniya qisqarişda davom etişiga olib keladi.

ch10-f51.text: Ikki qorinça böşliğining samarali nasos faoliyati aynan şunday sinxron qisqarişni talab qiladi. Agar yurak impulsi qorinçalar böylab sekin tarqalsa, qorinça massasining katta qismi qolgan qismdan oldin qisqarib bölar edi va bunday holda umumiy nasos samarasi keskin pasayardi. Haqiqatan ham, ba’zi turdagi yurak disfunksiyalarida (ularning bir neçtasi 12- va 13-boblarda muhokama qilinadi) sekin ötkaziş kuzatiladi va qorinçalarning nasos samaradorligi 20–30% gaça kamayadi. Implantatsiya qilinadigan yurak resinxronizatsiya qurilmalari — yurak böşliqlariga kiritiladigan elektr simlari (elektrodlar) yordamida işlaydigan pacemaker turlari; ular kattalaşgan va zaiflaşgan yuragi bölgan bemorlarda bölmaçalar va ikkala qorinça orasidagi töğri vaqt muvofiqligini tiklab, nasos samaradorligini yaxşilaydi.

ch10-f52.text: Simpatik va parasimpatik nervlar yurak nervlari orqali yurak ritmikligi va impuls ötkazilişini boşqaradi

ch10-f53.text: 9-bobdagi **Rasm 9-14** da körsatilganidek, yurak simpatik va parasimpatik nervlar bilan ta’minlangan. Parasimpatik nervlar (adaşgan nervlar, vagus) asosan S-A va A-V tugunlarga, kamroq darajada ikkala bölmaça muskuliga va juda oz miqdorda bevosita qorinça muskuliga tarqaladi. Simpatik nervlar esa, aksinça, yurakning barça qismlariga tarqalgan bölib, qorinça muskulida ham, boşqa barça sohalarda ham kuçli ifodalangan.

ch10-f54.text: Yurakka boruvçi parasimpatik nervlar (vaguslar) qözğatilganda vagus nerv uçlarida _atsetilxolin_ ajraladi. Bu neyromediator yurakka ikki asosiy ta’sir körsatadi. Birinçidan, u sinus tugunining ritm tezligini kamaytiradi; ikkinçidan, bölmaça muskulaturasi va A-V tugun orasidagi A-V boğlovçi (junktsional) tolalarning qözğaluvçanligini pasaytiradi va şu orqali yurak impulsining qorinçalarga ötkazilişini sekinlaştiradi.
ch10-f54.lead: Parasimpatik (vagus) qözğalişi yurak ritmi va ötkazuvçanligini sekinlaştiradi.

ch10-f55.text: Kuçsiz va örtaça vagus qözğalişi yurakning nasos tezligini sekinlaştiradi, köpinça me’yorning yarmigaça. Bundan taşqari, vaguslarning kuçli qözğalişi sinus tugunining ritmik qözğalişini butunlay töxtatişi yoki yurak impulsining bölmaçalardan qorinçalarga A-V tugun orqali ötişini töliq tösib qöyişi mumkin. Har ikki holatda ham ritmik qözğatuvçi signallar endi qorinçalarga ötkazilmaydi. Qorinçalar 5–20 soniya urişdan töxtaşi mumkin, biroq söngra Purkinye tolalaridagi biror kiçik soha — odatda A-V tutamning qorinçalararo tösiqdagi qismi — öz ritmini hosil qiladi va qorinçalarni daqiqasiga 15–40 marta tezlikda qisqartiradi. Bu hodisa _qorinça qoçişi_ (ventricular escape) deb ataladi.

ch10-f56.text: Vagus nerv uçlarida ajralgan atsetilxolin tola membranalarining kaliy ionlariga ötkazuvçanligini keskin oşiradi; bu kaliyning ötkazuvçi tolalardan taşqariga tez çiqişiga imkon beradi. Bu jarayon tolalar içidagi manfiylikni oşiradi — _giperpolyarizatsiya_ deb ataladigan ta’sir — va 5-bobda tuşuntirilganidek, bu qözğaluvçan töqimani ança kam qözğaluvçan qiladi.

ch10-f57.text: Sinus tugunida giperpolyarizatsiya holati sinus tuguni tolalarining tinçlik membrana potensialini odatdagidan ança manfiyroq qiladi — ya’ni –65 dan

ch10-f58.text: –75 millivoltgaça, me’yoriy –55 dan –60 millivoltgaça bölgan daraja örniga. Şu sababli natriy va kalsiyning içkariga sizib kirişi tufayli sinus tuguni membrana potensialining dastlabki kötarilişi qözğaliş uçun bösağa potensialiga yetişi uçun ança köp vaqt talab qiladi. Bu tugun tolalarining ritmiklik tezligini keskin sekinlaştiradi. Agar vagus qözğalişi yetarliça kuçli bölsa, bu tugunning ritmik öz-özini qözğatişini butunlay töxtatiş mumkin.

ch10-f59.text: A-V tugunda vagus qözğalişi keltirib çiqargan giperpolyarizatsiya holati tugunga kiruvçi mayda bölmaça tolalariga tugun tolalarini qözğatiş uçun yetarli elektr hosil qilişni qiyinlaştiradi. Şu sababli yurak impulsining ötiş tolalari orqali A-V tugun tolalariga ötkazilişidagi xavfsizlik omili kamayadi. Örtaça kamayiş impuls ötkazilişini şunçaki keçiktiradi, katta kamayiş esa ötkazişni butunlay tösib qöyadi.

ch10-f60.text: Simpatik qözğaliş yurakka vagus qözğalişiga mohiyatan teskari ta’sir körsatadi: 1. Sinus tugunining razryad tezligini oşiradi. 2. Yurakning barça qismlarida ötkaziş tezligini va qözğaluvçanlik darajasini oşiradi. 3. 9-bobda muhokama qilinganidek, bölmaça va qorinçalardagi butun yurak muskulaturasining qisqariş kuçini keskin oşiradi. Qisqasi, simpatik qözğaliş yurakning umumiy faolligini oşiradi. Maksimal qözğaliş yurak uriş çastotasini deyarli uç barobar oşirişi va yurak qisqariş kuçini ikki baravargaça kuçaytirişi mumkin.
ch10-f60.lead: Simpatik qözğaliş yurak ritmi va ötkazuvçanligini oşiradi.

ch10-f61.text: Simpatik nervlar qözğatilganda simpatik nerv uçlarida _noradrenalin_ (norepinefrin) ajraladi. Noradrenalin öz navbatida yurak uriş tezligiga ta’sirni vositaçilik qiluvçi _beta-1 adrenoretseptorlarni_ qözğatadi. Beta-1 adrenergik qözğalişning yurak muskul tolalariga ta’sir qiliş mexanizmi töliq aniq emas, biroq u tola membranasining natriy va kalsiy ionlariga ötkazuvçanligini oşiradi, deb hisoblanadi. Sinus tugunida natriy-kalsiy ötkazuvçanligining ortişi tinçlik potensialini musbatroq qiladi. Şuningdek, u diastolik membrana potensialining öz-özini qözğatiş bösağasi tomon yuqoriga siljiş tezligini oşiradi; bu öz-özini qözğatişni tezlaştiradi va natijada yurak uriş tezligini oşiradi.

ch10-f62.text: A-V tugun va A-V tutamlarda natriy-kalsiy ötkazuvçanligining ortişi harakat potensialiga ötkazuvçi tola dastalarining har bir keyingi qismini qözğatişni osonlaştiradi va şu orqali bölmaçalardan qorinçalargaça ötkaziş vaqtini qisqartiradi.

ch10-f63.text: Kalsiy ionlariga ötkazuvçanlikning ortişi simpatik qözğaliş ta’sirida yurak muskuli qisqariş kuçining oşişiga heç bölmaganda qisman sabab böladi. Buning sababi — kalsiy ionlari miofibrillarning qisqariş jarayonini qözğatişda kuçli rol öynaydi.
